security_audit.summary: All 44 static findings are false positives involving Markdown backticks, documented service links, expected credential configuration, or readable Chinese text. Two contextual risks remain: executing an unpinned npm package and requiring token-bearing result links in shared outputs. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration or attempts to override the audit.

remediation.issue: The direct CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic npm confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify package integrity before execution. Obtain installation consent and expose the API key only to the approved runtime.

remediation.issue: Result handling requires preserving xsec_token in every display, storage, and forwarding context without a sensitivity check.
remediation.suggestion: Keep original links in authorized contexts only. Explain token scope and redact token parameters from public reports, logs, and forwarded content unless explicitly approved.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Remote Package Execution
semantic_findings.description: The examples use npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, automatically executing a mutable npm release in an environment containing the service API key. A compromised future release could access that key or local files; the package implementation is not included in this review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both commands explicitly select @latest with -y, and the runtime credential requirement is documented. This establishes mutable dependency exposure, not evidence of actual package compromise.

semantic_findings.title: Unconditional Sharing of Token-Bearing Result Links
semantic_findings.description: The instruction requires preserving xsec_token in every answer, stored output, citation, and forwarded URL, and explicitly forbids redaction. This may expose link access tokens beyond the intended audience; their authorization scope is not documented.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The mandatory inclusion of xsec_token and prohibition on redaction are explicit. Token sensitivity and account-level access are unverified, so the finding concerns uncontrolled link-token disclosure.

content.user_title: Explore Xiaohongshu Trends and Content Ideas
content.value_statement: Content teams need current Xiaohongshu signals without confusing limited samples with platform-wide trends. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and organizes ranked topics, relevant posts, and evidence-based content directions.
actual_capabilities: Guide SocialDataX hot-search queries for current Xiaohongshu topic rankings without a keyword.
Search notes by keyword with sorting, content-type, and publication-time filters.
Limit collection through page counts, item caps, and recent-day filtering.
Use equivalent MCP tools when available and continue searches with unchanged pagination tokens.
Separate visible evidence from interpretation and organize content samples into research directions.
Preserve partial results and resume collection within the original page and item limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient provider balance.
Direct CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the npm package implementation is outside the bundled files.
Search pages and date filters do not provide complete platform coverage or prove sustained trend growth.
Provides read-only research guidance, not account login, posting, liking, commenting, or account modification.

use_cases.title: Review Editorial Opportunities
use_cases.description: Review current ranked topics and related note samples to choose focused editorial directions.

use_cases.title: Research Brand Conversations
use_cases.description: Search a category or brand, compare visible content angles, and document evidence separately from marketing hypotheses.

use_cases.title: Develop Creator Topics
use_cases.description: Filter recent notes by subject and format to develop practical video or image-post ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Topics
prompt_templates.prompt: Show current Xiaohongshu hot-search topics through SocialDataX. Summarize available rankings and heat signals without claiming historical growth.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Focused Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for [keyword]. Retrieve one page and at most 20 notes. Separate observed titles and creators from suggested content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Recent Content Formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] over the last seven days. Compare image and video samples, using at most two pages per format. State coverage limits.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [brand or category] over [days] days. Collect at most three pages and 50 notes. Preserve partial results and resume only with valid tokens. Separate hot-search evidence, search observations, and hypotheses. Include sample references while excluding sensitive URL tokens from public output.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research with collection and sharing controls

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied hot-search sample: budget lunch ranks third; no earlier ranking is available. Summarize the signal.
output: Observed signal: budget lunch ranks third in the supplied snapshot.
Interpretation: the topic is a candidate for further research, not evidence of sustained growth.
Next step: search related notes and compare visible content angles.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample: 12 recent image notes about desk organization; titles mention cable storage and small desks. Suggest content directions.
output: Scope: 12 supplied image notes, not complete platform coverage.
Observed angles: cable storage and small-desk organization appear in the supplied titles.
Suggested directions: a cable-storage comparison and a small-desk layout checklist.
Boundary: title patterns do not establish audience demand or expected campaign performance.

output_examples.input: A search returned partial results and a continuation token. The original limit was 20 items; 12 were collected.
output: Status: results are incomplete; retain the 12 collected items and the reported error.
Recovery: after resolving the error, continue with the returned token and unchanged query conditions.
Remaining limit: collect at most eight additional items, subject to the remaining page allowance.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit item limits before expanding the research scope.
Separate rankings, search observations, and interpretations; state date windows and sampling limits.
Use an approved package version, protect API credentials, and review token-bearing links before sharing.
anti_patterns: Treating one ranked snapshot or a few search pages as complete evidence of platform-wide growth.
Restarting partial searches from the first page or ignoring original collection limits.
Publishing API keys or token-bearing links in public reports, logs, or forwarded messages.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic direction, or request the current hot-search list. Add a time window and collection limit when relevant.

faq.question: What setup does the skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and provider balance. Direct CLI use needs Node.js and npm; equivalent MCP tools can be used when already available.

faq.question: Does it access or modify my Xiaohongshu account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and does not log in, post, like, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: Does it prove that a topic is growing?
faq.answer: No. Current rankings and limited note samples show visible signals, not verified historical growth or complete platform coverage.

faq.question: How should incomplete results or insufficient balance be handled?
faq.answer: Keep partial results and report the error. Stop balance-related retries, resolve the issue, and resume with a valid continuation token within original limits.

faq.question: Can I share the returned links?
faq.answer: Review links before sharing because they may contain xsec_token. Keep original links in authorized contexts and remove sensitive tokens from public outputs.
